newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Taleban militia, army clash in east Afghan town.
newsitem.headline: Taleban militia, army clash in east Afghan town.

text.p: Afghanistan's rebel Taleban Islamic militia entered the country's main eastern town of Jalalabad on Wednesday and were fighting government troops who had seized it earlier in the day, a government spokesman said.
Spokesman Amrullah told reporters that government forces had lost control of Jalalabad airport and street fighting was raging in the town, the capital of Nangarhar province.
